pages.title: Acheronite Crystal
pages.text: Crystals that grow on frozen dirt, sand and obsidian below $(bold)-60°C$().

pages.title: Where
pages.text: $(bold)Orbital Scan #0071$()$(li)Phase 5: rare$(li)Phase 6: common, faster growing$(br2)$(flavor)Named after the river of the dead. Naming things after doom is how orbital command copes.$()

pages.title: Growth
pages.text: Bud, medium, large cluster, full crystal.$(br2)$(bold)Only full crystals drop shards$(); earlier stages shatter. Any pickaxe; Fortune adds shards.$(br2)$(danger)Don't hold shards bare-handed.$() See $(l:orsa_rd/frostbite_warning)Frostbite$(/l).
